seo.title: Hire a Project Director | HumAIn
seo.description: Hire a pre-qualified Project Director who has led complex capital projects to completion, assessed on delivery track record, leadership and fit.

header.title: Project Director,
header.text: A Project Director carries the outcome: scope, budget, schedule and the people who deliver them. We put forward directors who have led complex capital projects to completion, not just through kick-off.

split.title: One person accountable
split.text: The Project Director aligns client, contractors and the project team, sets the controls that keep delivery honest, and makes the calls when trade-offs get hard. We assess every candidate on what they actually delivered.
bullets: End-to-end ownership of scope, cost and schedule
Clear governance and decision-making
Stakeholder trust from board to site

grid.title: Where a Project Director makes the difference
grid.text: The responsibilities we test for before a director enters our pool.
cards: Execution plan, contracting approach and delivery model.
Decision rights, stage gates and a reporting rhythm that works.
Accountable for the final cost, not just the estimate.
Keeps the critical path visible and protected.
Sees exposure early and acts before it lands.
Builds and steers a multi-party delivery team.

seo.title: Hire a Cost Controller | HumAIn
seo.description: Hire a pre-qualified Cost Controller who keeps budget, commitments and forecast honest on complex projects, assessed on real delivery, not a polished resume.

header.title: Cost Controller,
header.text: A Cost Controller keeps budget, commitments and forecast in one honest picture. We match you with controllers who have run cost on complex projects and can show the numbers they owned.

split.title: Cost you can trust,
split.text: From the first budget to the final account, the Cost Controller tracks what is committed, spent and still to come, and explains the gap before it becomes a surprise. We check that track record before they enter the pool.
bullets: Budget, commitments and actuals in one view
Forecasts that hold up under scrutiny
Early warning on overruns

grid.title: What a Cost Controller delivers
grid.text: The artefacts and routines we expect a controller to run from day one.
cards: A budget structure that matches how the work is done.
Every order and contract tied to its budget line.
A defensible estimate of the final cost, updated each period.
CPI and cost variance that show where money goes.
Clear period reports for the project team and leadership.
The cost of every change priced and traced.

seo.title: Hire a Change Manager | HumAIn
seo.description: Hire a pre-qualified Change Manager who controls scope changes, variations and claims on complex projects, with a baseline that stays defensible.

header.title: Change Manager,
header.text: Every project changes. A Change Manager makes sure each change is captured, priced, approved and traced, so the baseline stays defensible and nothing is lost between parties.

split.title: Changes captured
split.text: The Change Manager runs the process from the first notice to the agreed variation: impact on cost and schedule, the right approvals and a record that holds up later. We assess candidates on changes they actually managed.
bullets: A clear change process from notice to approval
Cost and schedule impact on every change
A baseline that stays defensible

grid.title: What a Change Manager delivers
grid.text: The routines that keep scope, cost and schedule in step.
cards: Every change logged, owned and tracked to closure.
Cost and schedule effects worked out before approval.
Commercial changes priced and documented with the contract.
Approved changes reflected in budget and schedule.
Shows where change is coming from and what it adds up to.
Client, contractors and team agree on what changed.

seo.description: Hire a pre-qualified Project Controls Manager who leads cost, planning, risk and reporting as one function, assessed on real project delivery.

header.title: Project Controls Manager,

Reporting leadership can act on

seo.title: Hire a Planner / Scheduler | HumAIn
seo.description: Hire a pre-qualified Planner / Scheduler who builds and maintains realistic schedules in Primavera P6 and keeps the critical path in sight.

header.title: Planner / Scheduler,
header.text: A good schedule tells you what has to happen, in which order and what is at risk. We match you with planners who build realistic schedules in Primavera P6 and keep them alive through delivery.

split.title: The critical path,
split.text: The Planner / Scheduler turns scope into a logic-linked schedule, sets the baseline, tracks progress and shows what slips and why. We check schedule quality and delivery record before anyone enters the pool.
bullets: Logic-linked schedules in Primavera P6
A baseline and progress you can rely on
Delay analysis that explains the why

grid.title: What a Planner / Scheduler delivers
grid.text: The schedules and analyses we expect from a planner on day one.
cards: One logic-linked schedule across all parties.
An agreed reference to measure progress against.
Status, forecast dates and float each period.
Shows which activities drive the end date.
Short-term plans the site team can work from.
What slipped, why, and what it means for completion.

seo.title: Hire a Document Controller | HumAIn
seo.description: Hire a pre-qualified Document Controller who keeps project documentation controlled, traceable and audit-ready across every party involved.

header.title: Document Control,
header.text: On a complex project the right document at the right revision is half the work. We match you with document controllers who keep every drawing, report and transmittal controlled and traceable.

split.title: The right revision,
split.text: The Document Controller sets up the numbering, workflows and system the project runs on, and makes sure every party works from the current version. We assess candidates on the projects and systems they actually ran.
bullets: One controlled source for every document
Clear review and approval workflows
Ready for handover and audit

grid.title: What a Document Controller delivers
grid.text: The routines that keep project information controlled and findable.
cards: Every document numbered, owned and tracked.
Always clear which version is current.
Comments and approvals routed to the right people.
A traceable record of what went to whom, and when.
The EDMS configured to how the project works.
